decisions.hidden_reasoning:

Considering Corviknight for its ground immunity and dragon resistance versus Garchomp, but ultimately I think Gholdengo's power and coverage make it the stronger third pick alongside Incineroar and Garchomp.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
My Incineroar is at 177/202 against an 85% HP Garchomp with lowered attack—Flare Blitz won't be very effective against its Dragon/Ground typing, and Rough Skin punishes any contact move I make. I'm weighing whether to bring in my own mega Garchomp instead, since the opposing Garchomp outspeeds Incineroar and poses a real threat.

I'm also considering Parting Shot into Gholdengo to further cripple the opponent's offenses while bringing in a strong special attacker, though Gholdengo's low attack and vulnerability to Earthquake make that risky too.

Switching into our own Garchomp looks more promising since it's close in speed to theirs and could threaten back, but I need to check whether its moves actually hit the opposing Garchomp for good damage given their Dragon/Ground typing.

I'm weighing Incineroar's Parting Shot pivot into Gholdengo too, but the Earthquake damage it eats on the switch feels too costly. Protect doesn't really solve anything here either.

On balance, switching to our Garchomp seems like the safer call — it avoids more Rough Skin chip, keeps us tanky against their attack, and sets up for a Mega Evolution plus Earthquake next turn.
